result.topic_en: Faint pencil calculations involving expressions such as $s+\frac{1}{s}$, $a^2-\frac{b}{a}(a-s)$ and $b^2\pm\alpha(b^2-s^2)$ with conditions equal to 1, alongside a rotated ink library/archival note in the upper right.
